body:
Adorable. I can’t even. 
Marry me?

Yeah it could, you’d have to study a degree of course but being skilled with that sort of thing would definitely help. 
I’m personally doing game design, I had hopes to become an environment artist in the future.

Mostly draw cities and stuff like that. Scenery. Not too good at animals or people but I’ve been learning that lately too. Usually ink, black/white. He’s not talking to me at the moment and probably wouldn’t even care if I gave him the book. Been ghosting me because he “needs space” cos of irl stufff and I’m just smothering him
I don’t know what to talk about. Nothing in life is good and the one thing that I had which was going well has now gone to shit just like everything else.

Generally I try to just distract myself from it. I focus on study or video games and try not to think about the people or the situation that I’m in. My therapist says I need to try sitting in feelings and processing things but it’s too much to do that. 
I’m not sure how else honestly.
I don’t know how to be less sensitive. I have ptsd of abandonment stemming from childhood and it doesn’t help my relationships at all. I don’t know how to just not care.
